FILE_IMPACT event must be extended with file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys; the derivation helper determines the tri-state: non-empty paths → 'paths', empty + payload scope 'none' → 'none', otherwise → 'undeclared'
CLI set-file-impact must move from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to support two forms: legacy JSON array and new --none flag; reason must have at least 10 non-whitespace characters
Library function rebar.get_file_impact_scope() returns {kind, reason, paths}; new MCP tool declare_no_file_impact applies same reason validation as CLI and returns plain string ack
Reducer state transitions must be tested over all ordered pairs {undeclared, paths, none}; paths→none→paths must clear and restore state correctly
Generated docs/mcp-reference.md and docs/cli-reference.md must be regenerated; rollback does not destroy events and forward re-deploy deterministically reconstructs the new projection
